intent.summary: Add a Hebrew public application for individual researchers or institution representatives under owner-published exact conditions. Submission grants no identity or access; private owner review binds a live selected personal code to a study and explicit permissions, atomically imports a draft, and partner folders show each partner's actual current grants across authorized studies. Preserve existing owner authentication, personal-code/current-credential checks, RLS, revocation, consent, released-document rules and immutable signatures; no production, email, paid service, or provider activation.

requirements.text: An individual may apply without institution; institution representatives provide institution and personal contact; preserve exact application and terms; show missing fields/unpublished terms honestly.
Submission creates zero identities, study memberships or permissions; guessed IDs/email/forged authority/direct DB access disclose no application or folder.
Only authenticated owner publishes conditions or approves; retries are idempotent; revision collisions do not overwrite decisions.
Approval binds owner-selected identity and correct study, preserves proposal, grants only selected permissions; newly created research code receives neither tool nor research grants automatically.
Partner X's folder shows X's details, all authorized studies and X's actual grants per study; Y cannot see them; owner/requested permissions are never misrepresented as X's grants.
Revocation of permissions or personal code blocks further access; executed agreement terms, findings-release rules and participant consent remain enforced.
Hebrew RTL desktop/mobile UI with no horizontal overflow, no private browser persistence and no false claim of email/signature/deployment.
